plain: Acting in agreement with rules, customs, or what others do.

webster.text: Likeness; correspondence with a model in form or manner; resemblance; agreement; congruity with something else; followed by to or with.

more.text: In theology, correspondence in manners and principles; compliance with customs.

example.quote: They will consider the conformity of the thing proposed or required to their immediate interests or aims; the momentary conveniences or inconveniences that would attend its adoption.
